svg.title: Punch — Prompty CLI component theme
svg.desc: Throwaway visual prototype. Loud hierarchy. Decisive actions. All 40 terminal components, with representative static states and a breathing row between selection titles and choices. Uppercase labels / heavy markers / reverse-video focus.
